The edited image appears to show one frog inside the bowl, another on the lid, and another on the floor, while the source has no frogs. The traces are valid, queried, and dependency-free, so this is not a transport or schema failure. Treat the reference label as an aggregate constraint, not proof that the visible bowl placement is absent or only partial; investigate why the reference says partial versus the repeated high-confidence complete judgments, and avoid forcing either label without resolving the criterion/evidence mismatch.
